description.html: The Atman HF-0300 is a hang-on back filter with a flow of about 300 L/h. On the box it is labeled Hang-On Filter, part of the Ornamental Fish Products line. It takes up no space in the water: only the intake tube goes into the aquarium, while the media box sits behind the glass, so maintenance is quick and you do not have to move any decor.

According to the packaging, the filter provides mechanical, chemical and biological filtration. Water is drawn up through the tube, passes through the filter media in the box and returns to the aquarium over a wide spillway, which moves the surface and adds oxygen to the water. It is suitable for freshwater and marine aquariums.

Hanging the filter requires a little free space behind the aquarium and an opening in the lid. Fill the filter box with water before switching it on for the first time. Rinse the media in aquarium water when you notice the flow dropping, and clean the intake tube with a brush from time to time. Never run the filter empty.
